tagline: Reliable local garden care. Done properly.
heroSubheading: Professional garden care for Kingsville and Yarraville homes. Done properly, every time.
aboutText: Bloomin' Bren's Garden Care has been keeping lawns and gardens across Kingsville and Yarraville looking their best for over 12 years. Founded by local green thumb Bren, the business has built a loyal following through genuine reliability, honest pricing, and a real pride in every job. Whether it is a quick weekly mow or a full garden overhaul, Bren and the team treat your property like it is their own. That is why so many of our clients have been with us year after year.
servicesText: From regular lawn mowing to one-off garden transformations, we handle it all with care and professionalism. Every property is different, so we tailor our approach to suit your garden and your budget. No job is too small and no detail is overlooked.

services.name: Lawn Mowing and Edging
services.desc: Professional lawn mowing with clean edging along paths, driveways, and garden beds. We leave your lawn looking crisp and well presented every visit.

services.name: Garden Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Complete garden tidy-ups including weeding, leaf collection, pruning, and general cleanup. Perfect for getting your outdoor space back in shape.

services.name: Hedge Trimming and Pruning
services.desc: Precise hedge shaping and pruning to keep your garden looking neat and structured. We work with all hedge types from small box hedges to large screening plants.

services.name: Pressure Cleaning
services.desc: High-pressure cleaning for driveways, paths, patios, and paved areas. We remove built-up dirt, moss, and grime to restore your surfaces to like-new condition.

services.name: Gutter and Spider Web Cleaning
services.desc: Thorough gutter clearing and removal of spider webs and debris from eaves, verandahs, and outdoor structures. Keep your home safe and looking tidy.

services.name: Outdoor Handyman Tasks
services.desc: General outdoor maintenance including fence repairs, gate fixing, light carpentry, and small garden structures. We handle the little jobs you keep putting off.

testimonials.name: Sarah Mitchell
testimonials.text: Bren has been mowing our lawn every fortnight for nearly three years now and the quality is always top notch. He arrives on time, leaves the place looking amazing, and is an absolute pleasure to deal with.

testimonials.name: David Kowalski
testimonials.text: We hired Bloomin' Bren's for a full garden tidy-up after letting things get a bit out of hand over winter. The transformation was incredible and the price was very fair. Highly recommend to anyone in the inner west.

testimonials.name: Jessica Nguyen
testimonials.text: Bren did a fantastic job pressure cleaning our driveway and paths. What looked like years of grime came up like brand new. He also cleared the gutters while he was here. Really thorough work and great communication throughout.

blogPosts.title: How Often Should You Mow Your Lawn in Melbourne?
blogPosts.excerpt: Melbourne lawns grow at different rates depending on the season. Here is our guide to finding the right mowing schedule to keep your grass healthy and looking great all year round.

blogPosts.title: Preparing Your Garden Beds for Autumn
blogPosts.excerpt: Autumn is the perfect time to refresh your garden beds before winter. Mulching, pruning back perennials, and adding compost now will reward you with a healthier garden in spring.

blogPosts.title: Pressure Cleaning Tips for Melbourne Homes
blogPosts.excerpt: Moss and algae build up quickly on Melbourne driveways and paths, especially in shaded areas. Regular pressure cleaning not only improves appearance but prevents slippery surfaces and potential falls.

blogPosts.title: Why Hedge Trimming Timing Matters
blogPosts.excerpt: Trimming your hedges at the wrong time of year can cause more harm than good. We break down the best times to trim common hedge varieties found in Melbourne gardens.
